cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm filling the overnight rota. If you're committed to the shelter, take the three-to-six shift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cover the phone from home. You can ring if anything happens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Good. I'll ring at three so we can do the handover together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could we do the handover at ten? I'll stay up for that, but I need my phone off by midnight.
